description: This file contains implementation code for the 't_getpreparam' and 'gettcid' functions related to SRP (Secure Remote Password) configuration management, including handling of preconfigured parameters and their retrieval.

methods.name: t_getprecount
methods.description: Returns the number of preconfigured parameter sets available.

methods.name: gettcid
methods.description: Retrieves configuration information for a given ID, returning a pointer to a t_confent structure.

methods.name: t_getpreparam
methods.description: Retrieves and initializes the preconf structure at a given index, converting base64 parameters to internal numeric format.
